source_text:
9.33 Μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ τῶν
πενήτων. Εἰ ἐπελάθετο τῶν πενήτων ὁ Κύριος, ῃ δει τοὺς πένητας ὁ Κύριος.
pass_a_gloss: Do-not forget of-the poor. If had-forgotten of-the poor the Lord, he-knew the poor the Lord.
pass_b_english: If the Lord had forgotten the poor, the Lord knew the poor.

choices.why: Lock has ᾔδει, not οὐκ ᾔδει and not πῶς ᾔδει. Do not invent a missing negative or ‘how’.
rejected: the Lord would not have known the poor
how would the Lord have known the poor

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
